scripts.dev: npm run build -w @voiceledger/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c green,blue "npm:dev -w @voiceledger/server" "npm:dev -w @voiceledger/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @voiceledger/shared && npm run build -w @voiceledger/web && npm run build -w @voiceledger/server
scripts.test: npm run build -w @voiceledger/shared && npm run test -w @voiceledger/server
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && playwright test
